pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.description: Set monthly or yearly pricing for this member plan. Price changes create a new version and do not change existing orders.
pricing.deleteConfirm: Delete this unreferenced historical price version? This cannot be undone.
pricing.immutableNotice: Only one active price is allowed for each currency and billing period. Older versions are kept for auditability and existing orders keep their original terms.
pricing.empty: No prices yet. Add a monthly or yearly price before members can purchase this plan.
pricing.savedDescription: The new price version is active and the previous version was kept as history.
pricing.invalidAmount: Enter a price of 0 or more and a valid trial period.
pricing.unknownError: The operation failed. Try again later.
pricing.deleteProtected: This price version is referenced by an order and must remain as history.
pricing.deleteRequiresArchive: Archive the active price before deleting it.
